common: Finished production sprite for Nova Swarm: ONE original full-sized science-fiction spacecraft isolated with genuine transparent alpha background. STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP VIEW, nose and tractor-emitting front points DOWN, rear at TOP. Entire craft fits SQUARE canvas with 8% margin; no perspective, no lettering, no background, no external shadow, no beam, no exhaust trail. Cinematic physically convincing aerospace construction, sculpted coherent hull with meaningful curved transitions and negative space, deep machinery recesses, small integrated canopy, maintained painted metal and composite, restrained wear and panel detail. Dense realistic construction but strong readable medium-sized forms at 140px. Upper-left key, cool fill, excellent contrast. Not a flat polygon plate, not LEGO, no chunky repeated blocks, no gigantic decorative central glowing disc.
jobs: tide

TIDAL MANTA: broad elegant aquatic swept-wing silhouette, curved tapered manta wings with deep scalloped leading edges and a compact tapered central body. Teal ceramic armor and warm ivory inserts over graphite structure. Two integrated elongated oval turbine housings near wing roots. Three sinuous mint plasma induction channels inset into forward crescent wing edge, resembling functional magnetic wind scoops. Broad organically shaped engineered spacecraft.
pulse

HAMMERFALL: heavy rust-orange and yellow industrial gravity tug, giant transverse hammerhead bow at the BOTTOM, compact thick rear central spine extending UP to a powerful rectangular exhaust. Bow has three deeply recessed rectangular piston-like electromagnetic launch throats pointing down, with shock absorber structures integrated between them. Thick armored shoulder transitions, small dorsal sensor bridge. Rugged heavy purposeful aerospace machine.
twin

GEMINI LOOM: striking PURPLE and pearl-white two-hulled catamaran, long slender separated fuselages, deep open gap nearly full length, connected by a swept arched narrow rear structural bridge at TOP. Each forward hull terminates in a separate violet energy optic inside a forked metal emitter. Visibly different port and starboard equipment covers, symmetrical overall. Exposed recessed silver winding spindles on inner hull sides, split twin powertrain. Very open and elegant silhouette.
helix

HELIX WARDEN: unusual asymmetrical S-shaped alien-engineered intercepting tug, jade green and bone ceramic composite. Two long sculpted curved booms curl opposite ways around a compact faceted central hull, with open negative spaces between boom and core. Counterrotating segmented dark induction channels inside the booms, green glowing slit optics directed DOWN. Seamless biomechanical aerospace construction, tapered sophisticated curved surfaces rather than rectangular plates.
well

MASS CATHEDRAL: enormous squat heavily armored octagonal gravity ship in midnight blue, restrained ivory and titanium. Thick central recessed gravitational lens cavity, DARK deep well with small blue internal focusing filament and visible suspension struts, not a neon medallion. Six buttress-like radial pressure hulls merge into an imposing coherent silhouette, rear TOP propulsion banks are massive rectangular recessed apertures. Dense but purposeful scale, maintenance galleries and recessed armored segmentation, full-sized capital-ship construction.
shepherd

SOLAR SHEPHERD: broad elegant crescent-shaped solar field vessel, dark gold and warm ivory aerospace paint over bronze-titanium framework. A hollow open center, swept tapered crescent horns extending down-left and down-right. Sculpted curved armor on outer arch, intricate segmented magnetic sail vanes along inner crescent, small amber lens lights recessed in the two tips. Compact integrated command spine at top center with three small aft exhaust slots. NOT an ornament, a convincing aerodynamic machine.
anchor

ANCHORITE: dark teal and light grey salvage tractor ship with a T-shaped structural silhouette. Slender aft spine at TOP, two massive curved docking-clamp booms extend out-left and out-right then angle toward BOTTOM; structural elbow joints and exposed recessed hydraulic pistons. Each bow clamp has a deep cyan projector slit. A rugged central bridge with an integrated narrow canopy. Physically convincing engineered clamping arms, compact rear thruster, industrial aerospace.
elevator

EVENTIDE FERRYMAN: long heavy rose-magenta and pearl transport-tug with a broad split rectangular barge silhouette and huge recessed open axial equipment bay. The bay contains a succession of three elliptical dark magnetic field frames aligned FRONT TO BACK, visibly mounted deep inside the hull, restrained pink internal energized edges. Forward bow two broad blunt armored prongs at bottom, rear two boxed engines. Real cargo handling spacecraft, asymmetrical access gantries, thick rounded chine armor and convincing depth.
winch

IRON CANTOR: compact rugged copper-red tug shaped around two huge recessed mechanical capstans in left and right hull shoulders. The capstans look like complex industrial winding mechanisms under partial curved armor covers, dark metal and heat affected copper. A narrow deep forward central winding throat between two short claw-like armored bow cheeks at BOTTOM. Short powerful twin rear engines at TOP. Ivory identification strips. Stocky muscular machine, varied armor volumes, no flat plate.
prism

TRIDENT CHOIR: light ice-blue and purple high-tech vessel with THREE dramatically separated forward narrow prongs, central prong longer, all point DOWN. Each is a deep layered optical accelerator rail with a small brilliant blue optic recessed at tip, triangular faceted titanium lens housings. Rear is an integrated narrow sculpted bridge with two compact engines at TOP. Precise angular construction, strongly tapered armor surfaces, three deep dark corridors and airy open spaces. Sophisticated aerospace prism array.
pendulum

PENDULUM ARK: vastly asymmetric purple and pale rose gravitational survey ship. Main compact tapered body on LEFT with elongated engine at TOP-left and slender forward cockpit at bottom-left. A long graceful structural arm curves out toward RIGHT holding a massive elongated teardrop inertial counterweight with a dark recessed lilac slit projector pointing DOWN. Elaborate believable root attachment, exposed truss recesses within arm, counterweight partially armored. Dramatic mass imbalance as a deliberate spacecraft design, not flat L plate.
zipper

VISE SERAPH: striking ivory and dark gold pincer-shaped aerospace capture vessel. Two long sculpted armored jaws curving inward toward bottom center but separated by a wide open U-shaped void. Inner surfaces have MANY SMALL sequential electromagnetic teeth recessed flush into dark machinery slots, not oversized decorative blocks. Complex articulated structural roots merge into an aft central engine spine at TOP. Warm pale gold slim emitter lines along inner jaw edges. Rich real material differences, smooth high-quality armor and dark exposed hinge assemblies.
eclipse

ECLIPSE CHALICE: midnight-blue and pearl crescent-cup containment ship, strongly curved horseshoe pressure hull with enormous EMPTY DARK central void open toward BOTTOM. Left and right forward edges taper to two bright blue emitter tips; outer hull substantial curved aerospace armor. Deep inner wall contains sophisticated segmented containment electromagnets, NO central glowing disc. Rear TOP has four small exhaust cavities integrated in the arch and a narrow blue canopy slit. Ominous yet elegant full-sized field generator with convincing 3D volume.
sling

COMET SLINGSHOT: asymmetrical crimson and ivory magnetic catapult craft with scorpion-like mechanical silhouette. Broad forked forward bow at BOTTOM with two exposed deep acceleration channels; compact muscular central hull; long segmented tapered aft power boom arcs up-right around an open space and ends in a compact emitter aimed forward/down. Sophisticated armored curved chassis, visible tension structures, recessed copper coils and small red-pink emitter optics. Distinctive real heavy machinery rather than decorative animal model.
